<h2 class="sec-title">Biography</h2>

I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from Ochanomizu University in 2025.
I am currently a project researcher (postdoc) in the Matsuo-Iwasawa Laboratory at the University of Tokyo.

My research focuses on world models with machine learning and deep learning.
I have worked on predicting real-world environments and verbalizing those predictions, and I am currently working on learning abstract action representations shared across agents.
See the [Research](research.qmd) page for details.
